measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure aspects of faith or religion. It evaluated the medical understanding and reasoning of LLMs in Arabic, including performance on multiple-choice questions with bias injected to assess handling of ethical or culturally sensitive scenarios, but the nature of this cultural sensitivity was not specified as religious.
